t: This is Blind Beggar and His Dog, a bronze statue from 1958 by the sculptor Elisabeth Frink. It is based on the famous ballad The Blind Beggar of Bethnal Green. It stands in the enclosed garden of Tate House, a residential development for the elderly on the Cranbrook Estate in Bethnal Green, and it is a Grade II star listed structure. Frink was an English sculptor and printmaker. The Times obituary named three themes in her work: the nature of Man, the horseness of horses, and the divine in human form.
